differentiated instruction is a viable approach to meeting the needs of all students in heterogeneous classrooms.
differentiated instruction, based on student readiness, interest and learning profile, is a viable approach to meeting the learning needs of academically diverse students.

(a) the literature supports the need for differentiated instruction in mixed-ability classrooms, (b) there are many models for differentiated instruction, (c) differentiated instruction can be effective for a broad range or learners in mixed-ability classroom settings, and (d) differentiated instruction is a viable alternative to grouping for academically diverse students in mixed-ability settings.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development and implementation of differentiated instruction for all learners in heterogeneous classrooms.
the development of a theoretical framework and a model for differentiating instruction in response to student readiness, interest and learning profile in academically diverse classrooms.
how the classroom teacher can use differentiated instruction as a means of addressing student readiness for the learning task, student interest in the learning task, and student learning preferences.

there is a strong need for more research in the area of differentiated instruction and a call to action for teachers to begin using differentiated instruction in their classrooms.
there is sufficient evidence from research to support the need for differentiated instruction in response to learner readiness, interest, learning profile, and other learner characteristics.

differentiated instruction, based on a model that includes readiness, interest, learning profile, and instructional strategies, is an effective and efficient way to address academic diversity and to meet the needs of all learners in mixed ability classrooms.

differentiated instruction is an approach to teaching that provides students with multiple avenues to access the curriculum and acquire new knowledge.
teachers can and should differentiate instruction based on student readiness, interest and learning profile.
differentiated instruction is a powerful approach for meeting the needs of academically diverse students.

differentiated instruction, as a means to enhance learning for academically diverse students, is a viable and necessary approach to classroom instruction.
